criteria.requirement: Add the actual Validator finite boolean rule with schema-validated arguments and native error-tree integration. When enabled reject NaN/positive or negative Infinity and nonnumeric/bool values, support finite int/float and registered Decimal types without converting large Decimals through float, and work in nested records. finite=False and absent finite preserve existing number/min/max policies; do not alter global types or claim existing bool exclusion as a separate feature.
